notes.title: The biggest update for Universal Power is here!!!
notes.content:
[h2]
A new Character Customization and New Game+ have been added to the game.[/h2]
[h3]Bug fixes and a Gore component have been added as well. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745063/f0b24b737350d8086ac5bcb049f1fc9168d5aa5b.png[/img]


The "Gore component" is a feature in the game where, upon killing an enemy with a strike, there's a random chance for the enemy to be decapitated, cut in half, or have their arm/leg amputated, with blood spilling on the ground.

[h2]
Also, two new modes are currently in development.[/h2]

[h1]
Conquest and Challenge of the Universe.[/h1]

[h3]
Conquest: This mode is more of a survival experience, where players must defeat enemies and bosses, discover treasures to fortify their castle, and progress in strength within the main story and other game modes.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745063/83b54cb4139f9e96378bff524b6cf46befe8a35f.png[/img]
[h3]an image of conquest mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745063/97d24cce90a741e7aa8a659b29def84fe9b03e8e.png[/img]
[h3]an image of conquest mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44745063/b89b1041b34f724b0dc02bcb0704aa37118361c9.png[/img]
[h3]an image of conquest mode[/h3]

[h2]
Challenge of the Universe: This mode is exclusively for true warriors who are willing to sacrifice comfort and battle the universe itself.[/h2][h3]
If victorious, you'll be rewarded with a Ring of Power.[/h3]

notes.title: Thanks to all the curators who supported us
notes.content:
We are releasing the biggest update of Universal Power due to curators supporting us.

This update adds: a PVP mode for players to fight each other, multiple Bug fixes, new weapons and abilities and probably a new DLC!!!

we insure you that we will have bigger updates and a seasonal update routine coming to the game.

[h2]Again we thanks all the supporters of universal power[/h2]
